# Themes

The colour themes that come with the app: 22. Pick one with **Preferences: Color Theme**, which previews each as you move through the list, or write its id in the `theme` setting — one id, or `{ "mode": "system", "light": <id>, "dark": <id> }` to follow the system. A theme that misses the contrast floors in its original colours ships twice: the original, exactly as its authors made it, and an adjusted one that meets them.

| Name | Id | Kind | Variant |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tyto Light (default light) | `tyto-light` | light |  |
| Tyto Dark (default dark) | `tyto-dark` | dark |  |
| Dracula | `dracula` | dark | original colours |
| Dracula (adjusted) | `dracula-adjusted` | dark | adjusted for contrast |
| Catppuccin Latte | `catppuccin-latte` | light |  |
| Catppuccin Mocha | `catppuccin-mocha` | dark |  |
| One Dark | `one-dark` | dark | original colours |
| One Dark (adjusted) | `one-dark-adjusted` | dark | adjusted for contrast |
| Nord | `nord` | dark | original colours |
| Nord (adjusted) | `nord-adjusted` | dark | adjusted for contrast |
| Solarized Dark | `solarized-dark` | dark | original colours |
| Solarized Dark (adjusted) | `solarized-dark-adjusted` | dark | adjusted for contrast |
| Solarized Light | `solarized-light` | light | original colours |
| Solarized Light (adjusted) | `solarized-light-adjusted` | light | adjusted for contrast |
| Gruvbox Dark | `gruvbox-dark` | dark | original colours |
| Gruvbox Dark (adjusted) | `gruvbox-dark-adjusted` | dark | adjusted for contrast |
| Gruvbox Light | `gruvbox-light` | light | original colours |
